status: PROPOSED. Nothing here is adopted until the owner approves it; ENFORCED-EXISTING marks conventions an existing check already enforces.

model.residualCost: probabilityOfOccurrence x criticalPathMinutesIfOccurs x (1 - expIndy002Overlap), per failure mode, per scenario
model.combinedPrevention: 1 - product over adopted conventions of (1 - prevention); overlapping conventions never add past 100% of a failure mode
model.net: combined residual cost prevented - sum of competitionOverheadMinutes
model.provenance: criticalPathMinutesIfOccurs, probabilityOfOccurrence, prevention and overhead are MODELED assumptions, informed by but not equal to the measured minutes in FAILURE-DATA.json
model.probabilityOfOccurrence: probability the failure mode occurs in one competition build if the convention set were NOT enforced (based on historical recurrence across R2-R9, discounted for maturity); conventions an existing check already enforces therefore show the value that check secures

failureModes.title: Run stopped or clock misread before the deadline
Build target ambiguous or changing (catalog vs plan, mission text vs baseline, unstated priority)
Generated commands, workflows and environment never executed before freeze
Application fails to start in the WASM runtime
Environment literals (ports, hosts) duplicated across files
CI workflow shape wastes or starves runs
CI shell steps hide failures (no pipefail, swallowed output)
Concurrent writers conflict on shared files or shared state
Save reported durable without verified provider read-back (multi-writer, stale read, API limits, retry storms)
State machine bypassed, faults swallowed, unknown input silently defaulted
Frozen contract cannot represent the real data or the required inputs
Contract or package revision needed during the build
Tests that cannot fail, are never written, or over-claim what they prove
Requirement clauses contradict owner decisions or each other
Evidence or completion claims not bound to the final candidate
Approval records written or self-certified by agents; verdict not computable
UI content escapes containers; application CSS re-implements or works around Forma
Editable field binding loses typed input
Non-text contrast below threshold for status colours
Test hooks or secrets reach production artifacts
Schedule or gate design contradicts ownership or deadlocks
Required dependency missing from the lock or silently dropped

conventions.title: Execute every generated command before freeze
conventions.problem: Suite runners, SDK setup, deployment preconditions and browser installs generated into a package were first executed during a timed run.
conventions.requiredPattern: A package is releasable only after every suite command, workflow and deploy precondition it generates has run on the pinned SDK in a clean checkout and produced its expected result (or an expected refusal).
prohibitedPatterns: claiming readiness from synthetic gate results
patching a generated command inside a timed run without a successor package
allowedExceptions: live-provider suites whose credentials exist only at T0: run against the practice repository instead

enforcement.mechanism: r9.fsx suite-preflight --require-tests; launch-preflight.fsx LP checks; Conditor scaffold CI

requiredTests: negative control: a suite command naming two test projects (MSB1008) must be refused by suite-preflight
conventions.implementationCost: about 90 min per package release (one clean-checkout execution)
conventions.ownerApprovalRequired: none for existing checks; extending to deploy preconditions is a successor-package change
conventions.keyAssumptions: Generated-command failures recur whenever a successor package is cut (R5, R8, R9); suite-preflight already catches the MSB1008 class, so the residual is deploy preconditions and environment setup. Impact if it occurs is 20-90 min (R8: live suites unexercised to T+94, first deploy T+129).

conventions.title: Stop only on STOP_PERMITTED, clock from the T0 record
conventions.problem: R9 stopped at 115 of 420 minutes; R7 projected time from stale timestamps.
conventions.requiredPattern: The run clock is read from the committed T0 record; work stops only on requirements-compiler stop-decision STOP_PERMITTED or the deadline.
prohibitedPatterns: stopping because a gate is red
estimating elapsed time from commit timestamps
requiredTests: existing r9-replay negative control (tools/r10/r9-replay.fsx)
conventions.keyAssumptions: Probability is the chance an agent stops early or misreads the clock without the stop rule (2 of the 8 observed rehearsals, R7 and R9); impact uses R9's measured 305 min as the optimistic bound.

conventions.title: One scope source, pinned and fully itemised before code
conventions.problem: Agents built the 38-requirement catalog instead of the P0 plan; scope digest changed three times during readiness.
conventions.requiredPattern: docs/rehearsal-010-readiness/scope-manifest.json (digest pinned in the launch lock) is the only build target; every work item exists in Praxis and the scope checkpoint is committed before application code.
prohibitedPatterns: naming a catalog or mission text as the target
changing scope without a new digest and owner approval

enforcement.mechanism: r9.fsx check-sequencing; launch-preflight LP-04 scope digest

requiredTests: r9-replay WORK_ITEM_MISSING control
conventions.keyAssumptions: Scope ambiguity recurred in R3, R8, R9 and readiness; impact if it recurs is 60-240 min of misdirected build. check-sequencing already enforces itemisation; value shown is what that enforcement secures.

conventions.title: WASM boot smoke on the first CI build; bounded view functions
conventions.problem: R4 lost about 120 min to a WASM interpreter trap with Release debug info; R5's app could not start for 90 min (12,683 IL locals in View.project).
conventions.scope: Causa.Web and any F# view module
conventions.requiredPattern: The first CI job publishes the WASM app in Release and loads it in a browser until first render (boot smoke). View code is composed from per-region functions; no single view function renders more than one screen region.
prohibitedPatterns: a single projection function rendering all screens
Release builds with full debug info for WASM

enforcement.mechanism: boot smoke test in tier-1 CI (plan's first-render journey); review obligation for view size
enforcement.reviewObligation: Reviewer confirms the first CI run executed the boot smoke and that no view function spans more than one screen region.

requiredTests: boot smoke: page reaches first render within 60 s on Chromium
conventions.implementationCost: about 20 min to write the smoke step once
conventions.keyAssumptions: Two consecutive rehearsals (R4, R5) lost 120 and 90 min to start failures; R6-R9 did not, so occurrence is discounted to 15-50%. The boot smoke shortens detection, it does not fix the cause.

conventions.title: One source for environment literals
conventions.problem: R5's test-site port was defined in 11 places; a partial move broke main CI for about 28 min.
conventions.scope: tests, specs, workflows, scripts in the competition repository
conventions.requiredPattern: Ports, hosts and base URLs used by tests come from one configuration file; every other file reads it.
prohibitedPatterns: the same localhost:PORT literal in more than one file
requiredTests: conventions.fsx test: two files with the same port literal fail CK-02; one file passes
conventions.keyAssumptions: One measured occurrence (27.9 min); the check is seconds; CK-02 still finds the pattern in R9 and the preview app.

conventions.title: Workflows pass Conditor ci-policy
conventions.problem: R4 ran 152 workflow runs with 25 failed builds; R6 had about 90 min with no main result; preflight CI ran every commit twice.
conventions.requiredPattern: conditor ci-policy check passes for .github/workflows (per-ref concurrency, cancel superseded PR runs, timeouts, no duplicate push+PR triggers).
requiredTests: Conditor CiPolicyTests (rehearsal-006 fixtures)
conventions.keyAssumptions: Measured: about 90 min without a main result (R6) and 152 runs with 25 failed builds (R4). Conditor ci-policy already enforces it; value shown is what it secures.

conventions.title: Workflow shell is pipefail by default
conventions.problem: Shell steps hid failures in R6, R7 and R8 (bash -e without pipefail; tee pipelines that could not fail).
conventions.requiredPattern: Every workflow declares defaults.run.shell: bash (GitHub then runs bash -eo pipefail), or every run step declares a shell.
prohibitedPatterns: run steps relying on the implicit default shell (bash -e)
requiredTests: conventions.fsx test: a run step without a declared shell fails CK-03
conventions.implementationCost: implemented in this change; Conditor could absorb it as a CIP rule (proposal)
conventions.keyAssumptions: Recurred R6-R8 (repair commits, minutes unrecorded); CK-03 finds 23 and 39 non-pipefail steps in R8 and R9. Impact per occurrence is modeled at 10-40 min of hidden red CI.

conventions.title: Single-writer files and append-only shared state
conventions.problem: R5: 17 of 92 merges conflicted; R8: 26 of 49 merges conflicted on .ros state; strict ownership moved cost into 19 change-request commits.
conventions.requiredPattern: Every path has one owner (agent-file-ownership.json); compile lists are written once at bootstrap; tool state that every lane writes is append-only per lane or excluded from merges.
prohibitedPatterns: two roles editing one file
per-merge reconciliation commits of tool state
allowedExceptions: integration applies change requests to shared files
requiredTests: OwnershipTests: every path has exactly one owner
conventions.implementationCost: none for ownership; .ros merge policy is a Praxis change
conventions.keyAssumptions: Conflicts are measured as counts, not minutes; EXP-INDY-002 overlap is assumed at 30-50% because its strategy targets the same failure.

conventions.title: Durable means read back from the real provider
conventions.problem: Saves were reported durable without verified read-back in R2, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8; the double lacked GitHub's cache headers so CI missed a stale read.
conventions.scope: Causa persistence and save state machine
conventions.requiredPattern: A save is Saved only after the provider read-back returns the written blob SHA, read with the HTTP cache bypassed; in-memory and double results never satisfy a durability obligation; provider doubles replay recorded real responses including Cache-Control, ETag, pagination and size limits.
prohibitedPatterns: marking an investigation Persisted before a confirmed write
restoring 'Saved' from browser storage
retry without backoff

enforcement.mechanism: live-provider preflight (J3-05); Dokimos evidence category real-provider vs double; state-machine tests
enforcement.reviewObligation: Reviewer confirms each durability obligation cites a real-provider run, not a double.

requiredTests: read-back with stale cache must fail (J3-05 regression)
double replays recorded GitHub headers
conventions.implementationCost: about 45 min to record provider fixtures once
conventions.keyAssumptions: The most recurrent family (7 rehearsals/experiments) but minutes were never recorded; prevention is capped at 30-70% because each past fix covered one variant.

conventions.title: Typed errors through one state machine; no silent defaults
conventions.problem: R4 bypassed Sync and swallowed faults; R5 stepOr swallowed book faults; R8 decided unknown commands as Observations; contract drift compiled only because warnings were errors.
conventions.requiredPattern: Expected failures are Result<_, typed error>; state changes go only through the machine's step; unknown input is refused or preserved opaquely, never defaulted; TreatWarningsAsErrors stays on and FS0025/FS0026/FS0049 are never suppressed.
prohibitedPatterns: | _ -> on a contract union in decision code
try ... with _ -> default
assigning machine state directly
NoWarn containing 25, 26 or 49
allowedExceptions: exhaustive wildcard after every case is listed explicitly, with a comment

enforcement.mechanism: tools/conventions/conventions.fsx check CK-01 (warnings-as-errors) + state-machine tests (existing) + review obligation
enforcement.reviewObligation: Reviewer confirms no wildcard/default branch on command or event unions in decision code.

requiredTests: conventions.fsx test: TreatWarningsAsErrors false or NoWarn 25 fails CK-01
conventions.keyAssumptions: R4, R5, R8 evidence; CK-01 is cheap; wildcard-default detection is review-only so prevention is moderate.

conventions.title: Contracts proven against real data before release
conventions.problem: Frozen v4.1.4 cannot represent 487 of 1,315 causa-data events; the connection contract has no workspace; v4.1.1 had no command body.
conventions.requiredPattern: Before a contract is released, every event type in the pinned causa-data histories decodes to a case or to an opaque preserved Unknown, and every required input of the governing requirements has a field.
prohibitedPatterns: releasing a contract checked only against fixtures written for it
requiredTests: replay coverage: 0 unrepresentable events
negative control: removing a case makes coverage fail
conventions.adoptionStatus: PROPOSED; content addressed by v4.1.5 CANDIDATE (E1 all 50 causa-storage events, W1 workspace) pending ODR-V415-01/-02
conventions.ownerApprovalRequired: owner: ODR-V415-01 and ODR-V415-02 (v4.1.5 approval and freeze); the convention itself (replay coverage as a release condition for every later package) is a new rule
conventions.keyAssumptions: Not yet observed failing in a timed run because R10 did not run; the 487/1,315 gap is measured. The v4.1.5 candidate carries the fix, so the value depends on its approval.

conventions.title: Released contracts are immutable versions; consumers pin them
conventions.problem: Contract and package revisions cost 2-19 h each and blocked mid-run change requests.
conventions.requiredPattern: A released contract version never changes; a change is a new version with every consumer's contract tests in the same pull request; each agent records the contract version it built against and integration refuses a mismatch.
prohibitedPatterns: editing a released contract file in place

enforcement.mechanism: frozen-package CI equality (AGENTS.md); contract tests at T14 (AGENT-RULES)
enforcement.reviewObligation: Integration confirms each merged pull request names the contract version it was built against.

requiredTests: contract-version mismatch must be refused at merge (to be measured in EXP-INDY-002)
conventions.keyAssumptions: Revision costs are elapsed pre-competition hours (measured) but in-run cost is modeled; depends on EXP-INDY-002.

conventions.title: Every bound test has a falsifying control
conventions.problem: Tests credited with obligations they did not prove (R3-R9); 347 of 613 R8 obligations unverified because bound tests were never written.
conventions.requiredPattern: A test bound to a P0 obligation is accepted only with a recorded control that makes it fail; bootstrap stubs fail rather than skip.
prohibitedPatterns: skipped stubs counted as written
tags on tests that never exercise the obligation
allowedExceptions: record obligations verified by document checks

enforcement.mechanism: slice-gate/completion-gate assertion ratchet; negative controls (tools/requirements-compiler AssertionRatchet)
enforcement.reviewObligation: Reviewer samples one control per slice.

requiredTests: mutation control per obligation family
conventions.keyAssumptions: Writing a falsifying control for every bound test costs 6-15 min of critical path per build; modeled benefit only exceeds it in the optimistic case.

conventions.title: Reconcile requirements with owner decisions before freeze
conventions.problem: Clauses contradicting DEC-025/OD-INDY-10 and INV-04 vs SM-SAVE stayed in frozen packages and produced FAILs.
conventions.requiredPattern: Every owner decision that names a requirement is either applied as an amendment in the successor package or recorded as a waiver against that requirement before freeze.
prohibitedPatterns: freezing a package while a decision contradicts a clause

enforcement.reviewObligation: Package reviewer lists each owner decision naming a requirement and its amendment or waiver.

requiredTests: review checklist entry in the package independent review
conventions.keyAssumptions: Two measured contradictions produced FAILs (R5, R8); fix is pre-competition review only.

conventions.title: Evidence is bound to the candidate SHA
conventions.problem: Reviews and closures cited earlier commits (R4-R7); R6 re-cut a candidate (20 min); cross-session claims could not be verified.
conventions.requiredPattern: Completion is only completion-gate COMPLETE on the candidate SHA; every review, run and record names that SHA; a claim from another session counts only after the lead reproduces it.
prohibitedPatterns: carrying a review forward to a later commit
requiredTests: existing adversarial.fsx cases
conventions.keyAssumptions: Recurred R2-R9; completion-gate already enforces; value shown is what it secures.

conventions.title: Only the owner records approvals
conventions.problem: Agents wrote or transcribed approvals in R3-R6; the R8 verdict was INVALID; DA-R10-1 certified itself.
conventions.requiredPattern: Approval records are written only by tools/owner-freeze.fsx under the owner's signature; agents never write, edit or transcribe them (RDP-003).
prohibitedPatterns: agent-authored approvals.causa.json
self-certifying authority records
requiredTests: launch-preflight-tests.fsx controls
conventions.keyAssumptions: Safety rule; recurred R3-R8; enforced by RDP-003 and owner-freeze.fsx.

conventions.title: Forma first: current Forma, no containment workarounds
conventions.problem: Forma 0.12.0 fails 48 of 78 containment checks (fixed upstream in 0.13.0); R5, R9 and the preview app re-implemented or worked around Forma in application CSS.
conventions.requiredPattern: Pin Forma at or above 0.13.0; lay out with ef-* patterns named in the layout contract; application CSS declares no --ef-* properties and adds no overflow, radius or validation-state overrides; a Forma gap is filed upstream with a failing fixture.
prohibitedPatterns: Forma below 0.13.0
overflow-wrap/border-radius/[aria-invalid] overrides in application CSS
allowedExceptions: remedies recorded in the layout contract (e.g. --ef-layout-target-min links)

enforcement.mechanism: conventions.fsx check CK-04 (Forma version) + design-contract check + layout-tests (existing)

requiredTests: conventions.fsx test: Forma 0.12.0 fails CK-04; 0.13.0 passes
conventions.ownerApprovalRequired: owner: pin Forma 0.13.0 (v4.1.5 references the 0.12.0 inventory; ODR-R10-05 allows 0.12.x/0.13.x)
conventions.keyAssumptions: Containment defects are measured (48/78 checks) and fixed upstream; minutes lost to UI rework were never recorded. Requires owner approval of the Forma 0.13.0 pin.

conventions.title: Editable fields bind on input, through the field map
conventions.problem: A bound field without data-on=input lost typed text twice in R3; the R4 regression test could not fail.
conventions.requiredPattern: Each editable field is declared once in the screen manifest and F# field map with an input-event binding; ManifestTests compare both.
prohibitedPatterns: binding editable fields only on change/blur
requiredTests: negative control: removing the input binding fails the test
conventions.implementationCost: none if contract-first UI is adopted
conventions.keyAssumptions: One rehearsal (R3, twice) plus an R4 test that could not fail; cheap if contract-first UI (CF-09 A) is adopted.

conventions.title: Test-only code never ships
conventions.problem: A live token reached Playwright traces (R4); production exposed EnableTestHooks (R5); test-only code reached production (R6).
conventions.requiredPattern: Test hooks compile only under a Test configuration; traces and logs redact Authorization headers.
prohibitedPatterns: runtime flags that enable test hooks in Release

enforcement.reviewObligation: Reviewer confirms the candidate bundle contains no test hook symbol and traces are redacted.

requiredTests: bundle scan for hook names on the candidate
conventions.keyAssumptions: Safety rule; R4-R6 leaks; time value is near zero, enforced regardless.

conventions.title: Schedules read the frozen ownership; gates are acyclic
conventions.problem: The schedule model ignored file ownership (T+519 vs T+720); the slice-gate journeys rule deadlocked the plan.
conventions.requiredPattern: The schedule model takes lanes from agent-file-ownership.json and the slice gate's merge dependencies form a DAG; both are tested before launch.
requiredTests: cycle detection on merge-dependency edges
conventions.keyAssumptions: Defects found in the model and gate before any run (modeled minutes); existing tests guard them.

conventions.title: Everything mandated is in the dependency lock
conventions.problem: Central package management dropped FSharp.Core and skipped every test assembly (R8); a mandated layout engine was outside the lock.
conventions.requiredPattern: Every package a requirement mandates, and FSharp.Core, is listed in the lock and in Directory.Packages.props; a test run that skips an assembly fails.
prohibitedPatterns: implicit FSharp.Core under central package management

enforcement.reviewObligation: Package reviewer lists every package named by a requirement and its lock entry.

requiredTests: bootstrap test run fails when any test assembly is skipped
conventions.keyAssumptions: Two R8 occurrences (FSharp.Core, forma-workflow); minutes unrecorded.

conventions.title: Standard per-feature F# file split (Contract/Domain/State/View/Tests)
conventions.problem: Proposed in the directive; no finding attributes a defect or conflict to module layout, and ownership is already fixed per file.
conventions.requiredPattern: Agents may organise modules as they choose inside their owned files; the frozen project structure decides file boundaries.
conventions.implementationCost: would require changing frozen project structure
conventions.keyAssumptions: No evidence attributes a defect to module layout; costs are a frozen-structure change.

conventions.title: Stable requirement and field IDs, decoupled from F# names
conventions.problem: Field-mapping drift between UI and contracts; IDs module exists in the contract-first UI proposal.
conventions.requiredPattern: Fields and actions use UIF-/UIA-/INV- ids from the screen manifest; HTML ids and F# names map through one Ids module.
prohibitedPatterns: deriving HTML ids from F# parameter names
conventions.implementationCost: none if contract-first UI is adopted
conventions.keyAssumptions: Supports CV-18; benefit is mostly in CV-18 already.
